silhouette.reason: Big vault, long nose, receding chin and 40°-swung pointed ears read as a goblin from front and side; the cleanest silhouette of the five.
fixes: hook the nose tip more (hook 0.08 H)

proportions.reason: Head ×0.84, vault ×1.16, nose ×2.6 projection hold; eye spacing 57.9 vs 59.0 mm. The eyes are human-sized; goblins usually read better with larger eyes.
fixes: eyeball ×1.3 with a matching socket landmark scale

materials.reason: Vertex colour on the plain strip: skin zones (flush, lips, cool sockets, curvature cavity, mottle) separate by hue but not by roughness or SSS; hair is the same material as skin, so it reads as sculpted clay; eyes are the only glossy part (cornea clearcoat).
fixes: a skin strip with subsurface-like roughness/sheen and a hair strip with anisotropic sheen (material-artist)
darker hair roots and per-lock value variation along the lock (root → tip colour is set but too subtle)

detail.reason: Primary and secondary forms come from a real anatomical base (eyelids, nasolabial area, lips, ear helix/antihelix/concha, clavicles, sternocleidomastoid) and read cleanly under the raking light, but there is no tertiary detail: no pores, wrinkles, lid creases or brow hairs (brows are painted bands), and the SDF hair locks are uniform grooves.
fixes: LOD0 normal-scale wrinkle/pore displacement on the subdivided base driven by age
hair: varied lock widths and a parting instead of evenly spaced grooves; hair cards (planned)

wear.reason: Pristine: seeded asymmetry and age/weight knobs are the only story; no scars, stubble, blemishes, sun-darkened skin or dirt.
fixes: seeded scars/blemish decals in vertex colour (orc, dwarf)
stubble shadow on the human/dwarf jaw

lod.reason: LOD2 loses most of each ear (thin sheets under the 1.4 cm cell) and the nose softens: the silhouette changes at distance.
fixes: authored LOD2 topology, or keep the ear shells from LOD1

technical.reason: QA PASS at every LOD; 49k/13k/5.9k tris (no hair) — triangles go to the face; 2 draws.
fixes: drop the teeth at LOD1 (barely visible)
